description: Get available time slots for a bookable service on a given date (Wix Bookings). Pass the serviceId from list_booking_services and a date in YYYY-MM-DD. Pass the same `place_slug` you used there — slot times are returned in the VENUE's timezone, which is not necessarily the directory's.

place_slug.description: Venue place slug — use the same one passed to list_booking_services.

name: get_availability
